role.administrator.title: Administrator path
role.administrator.intro: Set the program up first, then add people and try a first trip order.
role.dispatcher.title: Dispatcher path
role.dispatcher.intro: Short lessons. After them you can create a trip order and send it to the driver.
role.ga-approver.title: General Affairs path
role.ga-approver.intro: Two short lessons. After them you can approve trip orders yourself.
role.reviewer.title: Reviewer path
role.reviewer.intro: Learn to review trips, correct closed ones and take the reports out.
role.finance.title: Finance path
role.finance.intro: Learn to read the reports and export the month to Excel.
role.viewer.title: Viewer path
role.viewer.intro: Learn to read the overview and the reports.
guide.first-look.title: Get to know the overview
guide.first-look.why: Here you see the state of today's work at a glance.
guide.first-look.ok: You know where to see today's trips and problems.
guide.first-look.2: Green means the trip is fine. Yellow needs a look. Red needs a review.
guide.first-look.3: Done. This is where you start every day.
guide.create-trip.title: Create a trip order
guide.create-trip.why: Every trip starts with a trip order written in the program.
guide.create-trip.ok: You will find the new order on the [[nav.trips]] page.
guide.create-trip.3: Choose the category from the list.
guide.create-trip.6: Done. The trip now has a number in the list.
guide.create-trip.mistake: If the destination is wrong, open the order and press [[trip.amend]].
guide.send-link.title: Send the link to the driver
guide.send-link.why: The driver records the start and end odometer from this link.
guide.send-link.ok: The order shows that its link was made.
guide.send-link.2: The button only works after the mailbox is set up in Settings.
guide.send-link.3: Click the order you want to send.
guide.send-link.5: Done. The driver opens the link on their phone.
guide.approve-trip.title: Approve a trip order
guide.approve-trip.why: The General Affairs approval is shown next to every order.
guide.approve-trip.2: Click the order you want to approve.
guide.approve-trip.4: Done. The approval is saved under your name.
guide.read-board.title: Read the Today board
guide.read-board.why: You see today's trips and the state of every driver.
guide.read-board.ok: You know which trip started and which one finished.
guide.read-board.2: Each column shows the trips in one stage.
guide.read-board.3: Done. Open this page whenever you want to follow the day.
guide.review-queue.title: Review the trips
guide.review-queue.why: A yellow or red trip needs your decision before it is closed.
guide.review-queue.ok: You know which trip needs a decision.
guide.review-queue.2: Each trip shows the reason for the remark next to it.
guide.review-queue.3: Do not close a trip before you look at the odometer photos.
guide.review-queue.4: Done. Check this list every day.
guide.fix-locked-trip.title: Correct a closed trip
guide.fix-locked-trip.why: A closed trip changes only with a written reason, and the old value is kept.
guide.fix-locked-trip.ok: The change and its reason show in the trip history.
guide.fix-locked-trip.2: Click the trip you want to correct.
guide.fix-locked-trip.4: Type the reason for the change.
guide.fix-locked-trip.5: Choose the field and its new value, then press [[amend.save]].
guide.fix-locked-trip.6: Done. The old value is not lost.
guide.read-reports.title: Read the reports
guide.read-reports.why: The reports add up the kilometres and hours for every car and driver.
guide.read-reports.ok: You know how to see the numbers of a month.
guide.read-reports.2: Choose the month to see its numbers.
guide.read-reports.3: Done. You only see the numbers you are allowed to see.
guide.export-month.title: Export the month to Excel
guide.export-month.why: The Excel file is ready to hand to finance or the vendor.
guide.export-month.ok: An Excel file downloads to your PC.
guide.export-month.2: Choose the month, then press the export button.
guide.export-month.3: Done. Open the file from your downloads folder.
guide.fleet-lists.title: Check the vehicles and drivers
guide.fleet-lists.why: The names here are the ones shown in every trip order.
guide.fleet-lists.ok: You know where to add a car, a driver or a place.
guide.fleet-lists.5: Done. Add here anything that is missing before you create orders.
guide.set-up-lists.title: Set up the trip categories
guide.set-up-lists.why: A trip order cannot be created before at least one category exists.
guide.set-up-lists.ok: The category you added shows in the list.
guide.set-up-lists.3: Add the trip category, for example manager car or rented car.
guide.set-up-lists.4: Done. Now you can create trip orders.
guide.add-person.title: Add a new person
guide.add-person.why: Everyone signs in under their own name and with their own permissions only.
guide.add-person.ok: The new person shows in the list of people.
guide.add-person.3: Press the add button, type the name and choose the right role.
guide.add-person.4: Done. A new person starts with view-only access.
guide.make-backup.title: Make a backup
guide.make-backup.why: A backup keeps your data if the PC breaks.
guide.make-backup.ok: The new backup shows in the list with its time.
guide.make-backup.4: Done. The program also makes automatic backups.
guide.read-activity.title: Read the activity log
guide.read-activity.why: The log tells you who changed what and when.
guide.read-activity.ok: You know how to trace any change.
guide.read-activity.2: Search by name or date to find the change.
guide.read-activity.3: Done. No line of this log can be deleted.
guide.privacy-choice.title: Choose what to share for help
guide.privacy-choice.why: You decide whether the developer can help you remotely.
guide.privacy-choice.ok: Your choice shows on the privacy page.
guide.privacy-choice.3: Read what is sent and what is never sent, then choose.
guide.privacy-choice.4: Done. You can change your choice at any time.
problem.login-failed.see: You cannot sign in, or the account shows as locked.
problem.login-failed.why: The password is wrong, or too many wrong tries locked the account for a while.
problem.login-failed.do.1: Type the user name and password carefully.
problem.login-failed.do.2: Wait the time shown in the message, or ask the administrator to unlock the account.
problem.login-failed.still: Ask the administrator for a new temporary password.
problem.password-rules.see: The program refuses the new password.
problem.password-rules.why: The password is short, easy to guess or looks like your name.
problem.password-rules.do.1: Type a password of at least eight characters.
problem.password-rules.do.2: Use letters and a number or symbol, and do not put your name in it.
problem.user-accounts.see: A person cannot be saved or their link does not open.
problem.user-accounts.why: The user name is already used, a field is missing, or the link no longer works.
problem.user-accounts.do.1: Open the People & access tab in Settings.
problem.user-accounts.do.2: Type a unique user name and fill the full name, or make a new link.
problem.user-accounts.still: At least one active administrator must remain.
problem.no-permission.see: A message says you are not allowed to do this.
problem.no-permission.why: Your permissions do not include this action or this trip category.
problem.no-permission.do.1: Read the permission name written in the message.
problem.no-permission.do.2: Ask the administrator to add it for you.
problem.sign-in-again.see: The program asks you to sign in again.
problem.sign-in-again.why: Your session ended after a quiet period, or an administrator signed you out.
problem.sign-in-again.do.2: Then repeat what you were doing.
problem.trip-not-saved.see: The trip order or the change is not saved.
problem.trip-not-saved.why: A required field is missing, or the trip is closed and needs a written reason.
problem.trip-not-saved.do.1: Fill the category and the required fields.
problem.trip-not-saved.do.2: For a closed trip, use [[trip.amend]] and write the reason.
problem.file-or-month.see: The export or import does not work.
problem.file-or-month.why: No month was chosen, or the file is too large.
problem.office-network.see: The program does not open from another PC.
problem.office-network.why: This PC may be set to "this PC only", or your network is not allowed.
problem.office-network.do.1: Open the program on the office PC itself.
problem.office-network.do.2: Ask the developer whether this PC was installed as "This PC only"; the network guide explains how to change it.
problem.try-again-later.see: A message says something went wrong, with a number.
problem.try-again-later.why: An unexpected error happened, or the system is busy for a moment.
problem.try-again-later.do.1: Wait a minute and try again.
problem.try-again-later.do.2: If it repeats, press "Report a problem" and mention the number shown.
problem.pc-needs-decision.see: The program asks for a decision about this PC.
problem.pc-needs-decision.why: The data folder seems to come from another PC.
problem.pc-needs-decision.do.1: Open the program on this PC itself.
problem.pc-needs-decision.do.2: Choose whether it is the same PC or a new one.
problem.licence-locked.see: Data cannot be changed, but reading, printing and backups still work.
problem.licence-locked.why: The licence is missing, has expired, or belongs to another PC.
problem.licence-locked.do.1: Open the [[nav.licence]] page from the side menu.
problem.licence-locked.do.2: Ask the company for a trial or a code, or paste the code you received.
problem.licence-locked.still: Send the device number shown on the page to the company.
problem.trip-value-refused.see: The program refuses a value you wrote in the trip.
problem.trip-value-refused.why: The value cannot be right, such as a wrong date or an end odometer below the start.
problem.trip-value-refused.do.1: Read the message: it names the wrong value.
problem.trip-value-refused.do.2: Correct the value and save again.
problem.trip-value-refused.do.3: A cancelled or closed trip cannot be opened again. Make a new trip if needed.
problem.record-in-use.see: The record is not deleted, or not saved because the same one exists.
problem.record-in-use.why: Trips use this record, or another record has the same name.
problem.record-in-use.do.1: Do not delete a record that trips use. Switch it off instead.
problem.record-in-use.do.2: If the name is repeated, use the existing record.
problem.mailbox-refused.why: The clock of this PC is wrong, or the secret does not match the one on the mailbox.
problem.mailbox-refused.do.1: Set the date and time of this PC, then try again.
problem.mailbox-refused.do.2: If the message stays, copy the setup code from the first PC again.
problem.value-refused.see: The program refuses a value you wrote.
problem.value-refused.why: The value cannot be right. Examples: an empty or very long name, a wrong mobile, an impossible date. A file may not be a real picture, or an address may lack https://.
problem.value-refused.do.1: Read the message: it names the wrong value.
